expires_today.title: The Humanoids Megabundle: Universes Unbound, Part 1 by Humanoids
expires_today.description: Comics like you’ve never seen them before
expires_today.long_description: A detective on the hunt for an ancient artifact. A universe ruled by futuristic technology. A climate crisis driven by swarms of insects. This is just a taste of what’s in store for you in this bundle of comics from Humanoids, full of old classics and new favorites! Rediscover classics from the master Alejandro Jodorowsky, from The Incal to The Technopriests to Son of the Gun and more! Try out new bestsellers like the mosquito-fueled climate change parable Dengue and the post-apocalyptic vampire survival tale The Last Ones! Immerse yourself in the imaginative stories and unique artwork collected in Humanoids’ 2000s relaunch of the iconic anthology Métal Hurlant! Those are just a few of what’s in this bundle of more than 30 great comic series from one of the best publishers operating today, so grab them now at the price of your choice, and support Reading Is Fundamental with your purchase!

expires_today.title: Linux: All the Things by O'Reilly
expires_today.long_description: Tired of that stale operating system? Add color, customization, and optimization to your workstation with the all-new Linux: All the Things Bundle by O'Reilly! Master the fundamentals of Linux with 15 eBooks that cover everything you need to know. Pay what you want for an expertly curated Linux library designed to streamline your learning journey with foundational eBooks like Learning Git, Linux Pocket Guide, and Practical Linux System Administration. Unlock what’s possible with Linux, and help support Code for America with your purchase!

expires_today.title: Clip Studio Creativity Collection: Paint, Draw & Animate
expires_today.long_description:
Design characters, create worlds, and tell infinite stories with this bundle of Clip Studio art and animation software! This bundle includes a 12-month license to Clip Studio Paint Pro Version 5.0, 2D animation program Moho Debut 12.5, Ultimate 3D Models Pack, 3D Poses, and Brush Packs for Clip Studio Paint, and more! Paint your digital artwork, design your comic, and put your stories in motion with this library of art and animation programs! Get all of these and more at the price of your choosing, and support classrooms in need with DonorsChoose with your purchase!

Keys Expire. Please redeem before July 22nd, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Framing, Carpentry, and Fine Woodworking by Taunton Press
expires_tomorrow.long_description: Interested in trying out woodworking but never knew where to start? A veteran carpenter looking to pick up some new skills? This is the bundle for you, chock-full of resources and manuals that will help you achieve your loftiest woodworking dreams! Learn the ins and outs of home renovation! Get a crash course in framing a house! Fill your dream home with cabinetry, tables, and chairs made by you! There’s a certain satisfaction in making the things you use every day, and this bundle will teach you exactly how to bring your woodworking projects to life. Grab these instructional ebooks now at the price of your choice, and support BINC with your purchase!

expires_tomorrow.title: Liminal Spaces
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
There are few things scarier than being trapped in a place that shouldn’t exist—and that’s exactly why we love playing liminal horror games! With the Backrooms movie taking over movie theaters this summer, now’s the time to see how well you’d survive in these hostile environments full of monsters and other oddities. Inspired by the Backrooms urban legend, in The Cabin Factory your job is to explore a series of cabins looking for hauntings—and get out fast if you find any! For a more traditional approach, The Backrooms: Survival turns liminal horror into a roguelike survival game you can play solo or with friends! Enter these cursed, otherworldly places if you dare at the price of your choice, and support Spaceship Earth UK with your purchase!

Keys Expire. Redeem all others before August 5th, 2027

expires_tomorrow.title: Humble Handhelds
expires_tomorrow.description: Worlds of adventure in the palm of your hand
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
What’s better than immersing yourself in a great story with compelling characters and a unique style? Being able to take it with you wherever you go! Every action and adventure game in this bundle has been hand-picked for your handheld console, as portable as they are fun! Traverse the barren plains and one-horse towns of Blood West, a Wild West horror game starring an undead gunslinger! Play as every member of a powerful family and fight the looming Corruption through dungeons and fantasy lands in Children of Morta: Complete Edition! Gather allies to win turn-based battles to save the land of Tahnra in Symphony of War: The Nephilim Saga! There are even more adventures to be had in this bundle of games, so grab it now at the price of your choosing, and support the Breast Cancer Research Foundation with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before February 5th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: IT & AI: 500+ Certification Exams
expires_tomorrow.long_description:

Ace your AWS, NVIDIA, Linux, and CompTIA certifications with this massive library of more than 500 practice exams and supplemental materials. Plus, your purchase includes the Machine Learning & AI Certification Foundations collection. Pay what you want for elite learning and help support the Python Software Foundation with your purchase!
Keys Expire. Please redeem before July 30th, 2027.

expires_tomorrow.title: Complete Character Creation for Games
expires_tomorrow.description: Bring characters to life in Blender
expires_tomorrow.long_description:
Dying to design your own epic game but have no idea where to begin? Been poking around in Blender but haven’t figured out all the tips and tricks? This bundle of Blender software courses will have you creating awesome boss fights and unique characters like you’ve been doing it for years! Learn the basics of character creation with courses on 3D, anime, and even low-poly characters! Bring them to life with comprehensive guides on animation and rigging! Let your imagination run wild sculpting orcs, dragons, mechs, and more! Get hours of resources and advice about all the details of game creation for the low price of your choosing, and support Girls Who Code with your purchase!

Keys expire. Please redeem before July 23rd, 2027.

expires_within_72h.title: Pathfinder Second Edition Bundle of Frogs! By Paizo Inc.
expires_within_72h.long_description:
If your tabletop game nights are croaking, you could use a frog-themed boost from this bundle of Pathfinder Second Edition TTRPG adventures and miniature printable sets from Paizo! This bundle includes the ribbiting–erm, riveting Dawn of the Frogs, a mystery set in the swampy mires of Bog Bottom, both in PDF form and as a physical boxed set (miniature printables included)! If frogs aren’t your speed, try out the Extinction Curse storyline, beginning with the circus-set murder mystery The Show Must Go On! Or take to the skies in a flying airship and search the wilderness for magical beasts in Howl of the Wild! There are whole worlds to explore in this giant Pathfinder bundle, so get a crew together, grab it while it’s hot at the price of your choosing, and support the Craft Emergency Relief Fund with your purchase!
